spec.description: Lane pressure, latency, prefix cache, speculative decoding and memory for the inference engine on the DGX Spark (veloGB10 /metrics, job dgx-spark-inference).
UP when Prometheus scrapes the engine and it reports velogb10_engine_alive = 1. DOWN when the target is unreachable, the engine reports itself dead (/health 503), or there is no data at all.
spec.title: Engine

spec.description: Requests holding a lane now, out of the lane count (--max-batch).
spec.title: Lanes busy

spec.description: Requests queued because every lane is busy. Anything above 0 regularly is the signal to add a lane (--max-batch).
spec.title: Waiting for a lane

spec.description: Median time to first token (queueing + prefill) over the last 5 minutes; idle when no request finished in that window.
spec.title: TTFT p50 (5m)

spec.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache over the selected time range (prefill skipped).
spec.title: Prefix cache hit (range)

spec.description: MemAvailable on the Spark as the engine measures it. Weights, n-gram table and every lane share this unified memory; GPU out-of-memory errors start when it runs low.
spec.title: Spark memory available

spec.description: Requests running and waiting against the lane count. Waiting above 0 means requests queued for a lane.
spec.title: Lane occupancy

spec.description: Context each lane's running request holds, as a share of the lane window (--max-seq-len). 0 = lane free.
spec.title: Lane window fill

spec.description: Request receipt to first generated token (queueing + prefill), quantiles over 5-minute windows. A cold long prompt takes minutes; a cached follow-up turn takes seconds. The histogram's top bucket is 300 s, so anything slower reads as 300 s.
spec.title: Time to first token

spec.description: Generation rate after the first token, per request, over 5-minute windows. p10 is the slow tail (lower is worse); it drops when lanes share the GPU or a long prefill runs alongside.
spec.title: Decode rate per request

spec.description: Request receipt to the end of its response, quantiles over 5-minute windows (long answers dominate).
spec.title: Request duration

spec.description: Prompt tokens / time to first token per request, 5-minute windows (includes queueing). The histogram's top finite bucket is 12,000 tok/s (dashed line) and cached turns land above it, so p50/p10 sitting on that line mean 12,000 tok/s or more. The mean includes cached turns. 0 means no request finished in the window.
spec.title: Prefill rate per request

spec.description: Requests finishing per minute, by finish reason. error and cancelled should stay at 0.
spec.title: Finished requests by reason (per minute)

spec.description: Prompt tokens computed (prefill work), prompt tokens served from the prefix cache, and generated tokens, per second (counted when requests finish, rate over at least 1 minute).
spec.title: Token throughput

spec.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. Drops mean conversations are being evicted from the lanes and re-prefilled. 0 means no prompt tokens finished in the window.
spec.title: Prefix cache hit ratio

spec.description: Prompt positions each lane keeps for the prefix cache while it is free (0 while a request runs on it). The next turn of that conversation reuses them.
spec.title: Prefix kept by idle lanes

spec.description: Share of speculative draft tokens the verify accepted. 0 means no speculative drafts in the window.
spec.title: Draft acceptance

spec.description: Tokens emitted per speculative round (accepted + 1); 1.0 would mean speculation is not paying. 0 means no speculative rounds in the window.
spec.title: Tokens per verify round

spec.description: Rounds per second by scheduler arm: serial = one request's own speculative round, packed = one speculative verify serving two requests (lane packing), shared_plain = one plain step for all busy lanes, chosen by the load-adaptive --spec-lanes-max policy when it measures more aggregate throughput.
spec.title: Scheduler rounds by arm

spec.description: MemAvailable as the engine sees it, its minimum since boot, and the page cache (collector, all hosts; not filtered by $instance). Below about 8 GiB the box risks GPU out-of-memory errors during long prefills.
spec.title: Spark memory

spec.description: GB10 GPU utilization (left axis) and power draw (right axis), from the Spark collector. Not filtered by $instance.
spec.title: GPU utilization and power (all hosts)

spec.description: Seconds since the engine started (resets on every relaunch).
spec.title: Engine uptime

spec.description: veloGB10 version and commit serving now.
spec.title: Engine build

spec.description: Bytes allocated at boot for per-position state across all lanes (trunk KV, indexer keys, draft head). Each extra lane adds its share.
spec.title: KV memory allocated

spec.expr: (max(velogb10_scheduler_last_step_age_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}) and on () (min_over_time(sum(velogb10_requests_running{instance=~"$instance"})[30s:10s]) > 0)) or on () (vector(0) and on () (max(up{job="dgx-spark-inference", instance=~"$instance"}) == 1))

spec.description: Seconds since the scheduler last completed a round or prefill chunk, counted once requests have been running for 30 s (0 when idle; the raw value just grows then). A large value while busy means the scheduler is stuck; down when the engine is not scraped.
spec.title: Scheduler stall (while busy)

spec.description: Tokens generated per second across all lanes, counted as each scheduler round delivers them (not when a request finishes), stacked by scheduler arm: serial = speculative rounds (including packed pairs), shared = plain steps shared by all busy lanes. Total is the sum; per running request divides it by the average number of requests running. Over 30-60 minutes it matches velogb10_generation_tokens_total within about 2% (the difference is tokens of requests still running).
spec.title: Generation throughput (live)
DGX Spark Inference (veloGB10)
